ICS 83.160; 59.060.01TXD 38Revised Standard from Last Update.1. SCOPEThis standard (Part 3) prescribes a method for determination of breaking load, elongation at break, load at specified elongation, elongation at specified load and tenacity of man-made fibre tyre yarns and cords taken from cheeses, cones, bobbins, spools,hanks, or tyre-cord fabrics.2. REFERENCESThe standards listed below contain provisions which through reference in this text, constitute provisions of this standard. At the time of publication, the editions indicated were valid. All standards are subject to revision and parties to agreements based on this standard are encouraged to investigate the possibility of applying the most recent editions of the standards listed below.IS 6359 : 1971 Method for conditioning of textiles
